name: Al Dubois
biography: Alan Claude "Al" Dubois (born July 30, 1947 in Magog, Quebec) is a Canadian television personality, weather presenter, actor, and narrator. He is known for being a Game Show Host. The game show Bumper Stumpers was created by TV actor Wink Martindale. Gained fame as the host of the game shows Bumper Stumpers and Travel, Travel. The 77-year-old game show host was born in Canada. His first work as a newsperson was in Ottawa. He has worked both for CKMI and for The Weather Network.
